digest.component_or_area: LLM eval fixtures and plan-review container evaluation
propositions: Container criterion cases in plan-review-container.eval.yaml lack children payloads, causing ValueError when run_case attempts execution, while plan-review-decomp-shape.eval.yaml demonstrates the correct fixture shape with children lists present.
eval_solver._run_criterion_case documents that a container criterion without children payload is a fixture error and deliberately raises loudly to prompt fixture repair.
12 cases in plan-review-container.eval.yaml are ineligible for provider_parity.eligible_cases() due to missing children, reducing the selected corpus from 30 to 28 items.
Each case's existing input prose already names its child tickets explicitly, so the required children lists can be transcribed without inventing new scenarios or changing expect labels.
Adding children payloads to all 12 cases requires no code changes to eval_solver or provider_parity; the existing _runnable logic will automatically admit them.
